assets.label: 天气预报塔
assets.paletteConstraint: low-saturation weathered blue-gray slate roofs, pale cool limestone and plaster, medium cool-gray fieldstone, charcoal iron, restrained aged brass, and cool cyan closed glass only. No bright saturated colors, red roofs, purple magic, neon effects or glossy futuristic metal.
assets.primaryRequest: a compact connected medieval meteorological observatory built on one broad square 2x2 footprint, with one low sturdy observation hall, exactly one integrated central octagonal observation tower, muted blue-gray roofs, one large roof-mounted wind vane with a three-cup anemometer, one attached shallow dish-shaped weather radar and two attached rain gauges
assets.structureRequest: preserve the exact authored Blender silhouette: one broad connected observation hall, exactly one integrated central octagonal tower penetrating the main roof, one wide octagonal tower roof, one clearly attached central weather-instrument mast, one attached shallow meteorological radar dish on a roof pedestal, and one attached gauge platform; the mast and weather radar are required functional silhouette masses rather than optional ornament; no second tower, no detached shed, no floating instrument and no communications satellite station
assets.detailRequest: refine the selected weather observatory while preserving its exact one-hall one-octagonal-tower silhouette, roofline, instrument placement and ground contact; add crisp blue-gray slate courses, pale weathered limestone blocks, dark iron brackets, restrained aged-brass instrument rims, cool cyan closed observation windows, a readable three-cup anemometer, wind-vane arrow, shallow meteorological radar reflector and two rain-gauge rims
